issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification Vocab issue for R5 asking the core terminology page to add Maximum Value Set guidance for extensible or preferred bindings and an Other Notes bullet for minValueSet.

additional_context: FHIR-26028, already fixed on the combined branch by 56f45036ce, belongs to the same maxValueSet terminology family and restored preferred-binding coverage in the maximum additional-binding row. reconciliation: Made an empty audit commit. Current source/terminologies.html defines maximum and minimum additional-binding purposes, includes the minimum guidance, and source/datatypes/codesystem-additional-binding-purpose.xml defines the corresponding maximum/minimum purpose codes.
